paragraphs.text: The bear backs off, black eyes trained on you. It makes a low grumble in its throat, then turns and shambles into the trees.

You have somehow survived a fight with a bear. You may check-mark the small box beside your  Fighting(Brawl) skill. If the bear hurt you, you may also attempt a First Aid roll and, if successful, restore 1 hit point. Now go to 79.
